opening.argument: The visible offer is a gift-card update in a coupon-deals setting. The video tells viewers to log in to their Coke account and redeem a Target gift card, while the description frames the material as digital and printable coupon deals. The description also promotes referral codes with an earning-after-first-redemption claim; that promotional language should be read as part of the presentation, not ignored. But the observed materials show no login page, credential collection, payment request, external destination behavior, or completed transaction outcome. The closing slide asks for ordinary engagement: likes, shares, and subscriptions. On this record, the video presents a rewards promotion, without evidence of a deceptive transaction or credential-collection flow.
